_about: Limits for scripts/perf-gates.sh (S179). 'metric' matches the start of an XCTest metric's display name; the gate uses the AVERAGE of the measure() iterations. 'deviceOnly' metrics are skipped in the simulator, which doesn't record hitches. Simulator baseline S179 (iPhone 17 Pro sim, M-series Mac): launch 1.41 s, strip memory peak 81 MB. 'simulatorOnly': the launch metric records nothing on Martin's iPhone (S182), so there the gate is the wall clock of launch() (sim 3.48 s = launch 1.43 s + XCTest's terminate/idle wait). Hitch gates use 'Hitch Time Ratio (Yomi)' (whole run), not the scroll-signpost one: S182 phone run, ONE 8.3 ms frame in a short scroll interval made that ratio 78 ms/s for one iteration (avg 16) while Yomi's was 1.3. Hitch limit = RESEARCH §25.10 #11 (Apple: under 5 ms/s is good).
